title: Reformed Baptist Church, built 1892
description: The Reformed Baptist Church was organized on December 3, 1888, and initially held meetings in Matheson Hall. In the spring of 1892, construction began on their own church building, which was dedicated on November 6, 1892, under the ministry of Rev. S. A. Baker. The congregation was motivated to build their own space because the remnants of the 'Wild West Show' left in Matheson Hall on Saturday nights made it unsuitable for Sunday worship.
